law_name: Law on the Protection of Individuals regarding the Processing of their Personal Data (Law No. 8968)
jurisdiction: PRODHAB (Agencia de Protección de Datos de los Habitantes)
scope: Individuals regardless of nationality or residence
key_requirements: Informed consent, data subject rights, database registration with PRODHAB
enforcement_authority: Agencia de Protección de Datos de los Habitantes (PRODHAB)
penalties_range: Up to 30 base salaries (salarios base) fine
notes: Regulation: Decree 37554-JP; reform bill 23097 not confirmed enacted
